displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: uptime checks have stopped reporting

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: the Google Cloud uptime checks have gone quiet
documentation.content:
No uptime check result has arrived for 30 minutes. The checks run every 5 minutes, so they have been deleted, paused, or Cloud Monitoring is having trouble. Without them the only watch left is the GitHub monitor.

What to do: follow docs/sre/runbooks/monitoring-is-blind.md.

This message carries no visitor data.
